title: carvera-scan
tagline: 3D scans on a Makera Carvera C1: a cross laser and two cameras ride on the head, and the machine's own motion does the rest.

projects.title: Cutebot duo
projects.summary: A Cutebot Pro and a Cutebot. Holes found on the height map, then measured by centring the laser cross in each one.

projects.name: blocks-123
projects.title: 1-2-3 blocks
